items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: I go over there and I see Pete Fancy with a little French cap on, a little beard, man.

ctx.x: Yeah, but, but. I was playing, I called Pete Fancy. So, I mean, I got to see them cats, man. I know about Eddie, you know. So, I go over there and I see Pete Fancy with a little French cap on, a little beard, man. Sitting on the bus, see. And I said, I said, Godfrey, who is? I know Godfrey. He said, where are you all playing, man? He said, across the street. So, Godfrey came over there, you know. He's playing with Pete. And the guy said, this is going to be on the table too. He said, man, he said, Godfrey did get…
When a guy's good, I see he's a good guy. He played in the same way too, didn't he? Huh?
